result: Narrowed; original node status retained. For arbitrary types, cloners on admitted blank slices compose to a cloner on their Cartesian product. Product-local reversible maps alone do not implement all permutations of two bits: controlled flip is an involution but cannot be written (f(a),g(b)). Product cloning therefore does not supply the full permutation-task clause of interoperability.
proof_boundary: The declared functional task model does not prove the physical possibility of cloning or joint operations with side-effects. The imported interoperability principle and any Hilbert tensor-product/local-tomography conclusion remain separate obligations.
